# Cell subgroups

Example output of
[`compute.deconvolution.analysis()`](https://verapancaldilab.github.io/multideconv/reference/compute.deconvolution.analysis.md),
computed on
[deconv_bulk](https://verapancaldilab.github.io/multideconv/reference/deconv_bulk.md)
with `compute.deconvolution.analysis(deconv_bulk, corr = 0.7)`.

## Usage

``` r
subgroups
```

## Format

A list with 7 elements: "Deconvolution matrix", "Deconvolution subgroups
per cell types", "Deconvolution subgroups composition", "Discarded
features with high number of zeros", "Discarded features with low
variance", "Discarded cell types" and "Cell groups" (`NULL` here: no
`cell_groups` were given).
